Hi Elena / Sam —

Great to meet you both on the discovery call today. Thanks for walking through the opportunity and the key success metrics for the Finovo rollout. As discussed, I put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures milestones, owners, high-level dependencies, and two timeline options (aggressive vs conservative). Please find the draft attached (Finovo-Redwood-MAP-v1.xlsx).

High-level recap / proposed milestones (from the call):
- Discovery & requirements sign-off — Finovo (Elena / Sam) / Marissa — Target: 1 week
- Security & compliance review (SOC2 questionnaire + network details) — Finovo Sec / Redwood Sec (Aditya) — Target: 2 weeks
- Proposal & procurement review — Finovo Procurement (TBD) / Marissa — Target: 2 weeks
- Integration POC (staging) — Finovo Eng / Redwood SE (Aditya) — Target: 3–4 weeks
- Pilot roll-out & success validation — Finovo Product / Redwood CS (Lauren) — Target: 1–2 weeks
- Production enablement & handoff — Joint — Target: 1 week

Two timeline options are included in the attached MAP:
1) Aggressive: ~6 weeks from MAP kickoff (compresses procurement and security windows; requires prioritized review)
2) Conservative: ~10 weeks from MAP kickoff (standard review cadence; more buffer for procurement)

Ask: can you confirm the Finovo stakeholder list (who owns security, procurement, and engineering sign-offs) and which timeline you prefer? If you prefer, we can default to the conservative plan and accelerate once procurement clearances occur.

Proposed next step: Kickoff meeting to review the MAP and action owners — options: Tue 2026-06-23 10:00am PT or Wed 2026-06-24 11:00am PT. I can send a calendar invite once you confirm the best slot and any additional attendees.

Attachments: Finovo-Redwood-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP draft)

Thanks — excited to get this moving.
